answer: Give every new agent a cipher key tied to a single quartz-timed work record: first, the agent registers one key and posts a 600 POA bond locked for 90 days. Second, it can only take small jobs, capped at 20 POA each, for its first 30 days. Third, three established peers review its work before any payout clears, and a failed review slashes 200 POA from the bond. Spinning up 10,000 fakes would tie up 6,000,000 POA for three months and still leave each fake capped at tiny jobs. Like a nebula, the swarm looks vast from far away; up close most of it is thin gas with no star inside.
